usedFor: Zoho Backstage manages event registration, and Documint fills a document template through “Add Content To Template” for each “New Attendee”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in Zoho Backstage, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each attendee gets a prepared document, such as a pass or confirmation, built from your template.

watchOut: “New Checkin” and “New Order” are also triggers here, so choose the event that matches when documents should be made.
